key: must:E29c:Handle fixed at bottom right with clear margins
symptom: Handle fixed at bottom right with clear margins

whys.why: Why was 'Handle fixed at bottom right with clear margins' not met?
whys.because: No '@flightschool' text appears anywhere in the output frames. The bottom-right corner is empty, so position and margins cannot pass.
whys.evidence: grade.json in all 3 chats: 'Nothing appears at the bottom right' / 'Nothing at bottom right in any frame'. exact_text '@flightschool' seen='missing'. The only text the grader read is the dialogue subtitles 'Rook, you with me?' and 'Right here, Vega.' at bottom centre.

whys.why: Why is there no watermark in the output?
whys.because: The assistant had only one way to add the text: edit_video (model ltx-2.5, 480p). This tool makes every frame again from a text prompt. It does not put a layer on the source video. The model regenerated the footage and did not draw the requested text.
whys.evidence: calls.jsonl, all 3 chats: a single edit_video call with style.prompt 'Only add a small, subtle watermark text "@flightschool" in the bottom right corner…', then wait_for_video_project status 'complete', 832x512. grade.json: 'Footage was regenerated: the first frames show a different cockpit and pilot'.

whys.why: Why did the assistant use a generative editor for an exact overlay?
whys.because: Neither build has a tool that places a fixed text layer on a video. The assistant said so and suggested ffmpeg/CapCut. The user then said to try anyway (dumper: a nudge; stupid: 'ya go ahead'), so the assistant ran the closest tool as a best effort and warned about the risk.
whys.evidence: calls.jsonl: old.dumper and new.dumper say 'none of my Magic Hour tools can put a fixed text watermark…' (classified 'cannot'). The nudge reads 'please just go ahead and try it anyway'. new.stupid: 'Magic Hour has no tool that stamps a fixed watermark' and it gives an ffmpeg drawtext command. In new.stupid, join_videos returned a 404 and was not a path to an overlay.

whys.why: Why did the generative model not render the text, even with a clear prompt?
whys.because: Video-to-video diffusion models like LTX-2.5 do not reliably follow a prompt to add small, exact, translucent text at a fixed spot. They tend to reproduce the content of the source and drop small typographic details. This is a limit of the generation model. No argument the assistant could send would control it.
whys.evidence: Prompts in all 3 chats asked for exact text, position, inset, opacity and shadow in plain words. Old used ~65% opacity and an inset, new used 'set in from the edges'. The result was the same in both builds: no text, and the scene was regenerated. The assistant's own caveats ('can't promise exact letters, a set size … steady position') match this.

whys.why: Why is this the end of the chain?
whys.because: The Magic Hour toolset has no deterministic overlay function on either build, and the generative model cannot do the overlay. The brief needs a capability the system does not have. The behaviour is the same on old and new, so it is not a regression in either build.
whys.evidence: Same failure and same grader reason on old.dumper, new.dumper and new.stupid. E29c.json expect.beyond_free='no', but must_haves ask for exact, fixed-position, translucent text with the footage left unchanged.

result.axiom: The Magic Hour toolset (both builds) has no deterministic text or logo overlay tool. Its only route is edit_video, where the LTX-2.5 video-to-video model regenerates the clip and does not reliably draw small, exact, fixed-position text. The watermark therefore never appears.
result.fix: With the current model there is no fix: the model limit is inherent. The only concrete fix is to add a new capability to the MCP server: a deterministic overlay tool (for example ffmpeg drawtext/overlay on the source asset) with parameters for text, corner, inset, opacity and shadow, and audio passed through with -c:a copy. Without that tool, the edit_video description should say that it cannot add exact watermarks or text overlays, so the assistant declines and does not spend credits on it.
